```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "en_US.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Los_Angeles"))
`inflation-europe-2017` <- tribble(
  ~source, ~dataset,
  "ecb", "CES",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_manr",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_midx",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_mmor",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_inw",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_cow",
  "eurostat",  "prc_ppp_ind",
  "eurostat",  "prc_hicp_ctrb",
  "eurostat", "nama_10_co3_p3") %>%
  arrange(source, dataset)
```

# Food

Methodology is not harmonized across European countries... Some have scanner data, some don't. France switched to scanner data in early 2020.

```{r}
ig_d("eurostat", "prc_hicp_midx", "DE-FR-IT-CP01-2017")
```
